agentPage.title: Agents
agentPage.intro: Your organization's agents. Each one specializes in your business, and you can turn it on, pause it and customize it.
agentPage.emptyDescription: Here you will see its conversation, what it has done and what it has pending once it starts working: with its instructions, skills, channels and autonomy.

descriptions.reception: Scheduling: creates, moves and cancels appointments, manages the waiting list and reminders, organizes resources and rooms, and answers the business phone line.
descriptions.customer: Serves your customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, email and the web: answers questions and issues, handles reviews and hands over to a person when needed.
descriptions.sales: Captures and qualifies leads, keeps the CRM, prepares quotes, follows up, wins back customers and runs the campaigns the coach proposes.
descriptions.admin: Invoicing through your own software, collections, expenses, inventory and suppliers, documents and the information your accountant needs.

agentPage.noAgentsDescription: Your agents appear once you belong to an organization: accept the invitation you were sent.

calendarPage.title: Calendar
calendarPage.description: Appointments at the locations you can see, each in its location's local time. View only for now.
calendarPage.empty: There are no appointments on these days at the locations in your scope.
calendarPage.truncated: Only the first {count} appointments are shown. Pick a location or the day view to see the rest.

approvalsPage.title: Approvals
approvalsPage.description: What the agent proposes and is waiting for a person. Approving sends the reply or makes the booking; rejecting does nothing.
approvalsPage.empty: When the agent leaves a reply or an appointment as a draft, it will show up here.
approvalsPage.truncated: Showing the {count} oldest. The next ones appear as you decide these.

errors.invalid: The decision could not be read. Please try again.
errors.not_allowed: You cannot decide this approval: it is not from your location, it was already decided or it has expired.
errors.slot_passed: This appointment's time has already passed: it can't be approved. Reject it.

detail.slotPassed: This appointment's time has already passed: it can't be approved. Reject it and, if needed, reply to the customer from the inbox.
detail.openConversation: Open the conversation in the inbox
detail.noConversation: It doesn't come from a conversation with a customer.
detail.others: Everything else it did in that turn

inboxPage.title: Inbox
inboxPage.description: Conversations with your customers in the selected scope: who is handling each one and the latest message. It refreshes on its own.

emptyTitle.human: No conversations handled by the team

empty.open: When a customer writes through a connected channel, the conversation shows up here.
empty.human: When someone on the team takes over a conversation from the agent, it shows up here.

inboxPage.noResults: No conversation in this tab has a customer named like “{search}”.
inboxPage.choose: Choose a conversation to read it.

status.unknown: Sent, but delivery could not be confirmed: check with the customer before resending

inboxPage.takeOverDescription: The agent will stop replying to {name} until you hand it back. You will write instead. The change is logged.
inboxPage.composerHint: The agent is handling this conversation. Take over to write yourself: the agent pauses until you hand it back.
inboxPage.composerUnavailable: You can't reply on this channel from here yet: {name} wouldn't receive what you write. You can follow the conversation and hand it back to the agent.

errors.invalid: Write a message before sending it.
errors.not_allowed: You can't do this here: the conversation is not in your scope, someone already changed who is handling it, or it is closed.
errors.channel_unavailable: You can't reply on this channel from here yet.
errors.failed: It didn't work. Please try again.

handoffNotice.title: A conversation was handed to you
handoffNotice.description: The agent stopped replying and handed it to the team.

testChat.title: Try it
testChat.description: Write as if you were a customer. The agent answers with the real model, and you approve what it proposes here or in Approvals.
testChat.realWarning: What you approve here is real: an approved booking takes up the location's calendar. Each message costs one agent turn.
testChat.empty: You have not written to it yet. Try “Do you have a slot on Monday?”.

errors.invalid: Write a message of up to 2000 characters.
errors.not_allowed: You cannot test this agent at this location.
errors.paused: The agent is paused: it cannot be tested.
errors.too_many: You have sent many test messages in the last hour. Please wait a little.
errors.failed: It could not be sent. Please try again.

knowledgePage.title: Knowledge
knowledgePage.description: What your agents know about your business. They answer customers only with what is written here.
knowledgePage.privacy: Write business information (questions and answers, prices, policies), never data about customers or patients: the text is sent to the indexing provider.
knowledgePage.mfaRequired: You need two-step verification to add or change sources.
knowledgePage.empty: Add your frequent questions, prices and policies so the agents can answer with them.
knowledgePage.emptyReadOnly: When an administrator adds frequent questions, prices or policies, they will show up here.
knowledgePage.newDescription: The agents will use it once it is indexed, in a few seconds.
knowledgePage.bodyHelp: Up to 20,000 characters. Separate each topic with a blank line.

statusHelp.pending: It will be indexed in a few seconds. Until then, the agents do not use it.
statusHelp.processing: It is being indexed. The agents will use it in a few seconds.
statusHelp.ready: The agents use it to answer.
statusHelp.error: It could not be indexed, so the agents do not use it. This happens if the indexing provider fails or if your model policy does not allow it (for example, EU only). Change the text to try again.

knowledgePage.deleteDescription: The agents will stop using it. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalid: Check the fields: the title can have up to 200 characters and the text up to 20,000.
errors.not_allowed: You cannot change the knowledge of this organization.

goalsPage.title: Goals
goalsPage.description: What you want to achieve, measured and with a date. Your agents will use it to prioritise and the coach will review how you're doing.
goalsPage.mfaRequired: You need two-step verification to create or change goals.
goalsPage.empty: Set what you want to achieve: appointments a month, qualified leads, response time…
goalsPage.emptyReadOnly: When someone who manages goals sets them for your scope, they'll show up here.
goalsPage.newDescription: Choose where it applies, what it measures and the value you want to reach.
goalsPage.progressHelp: Progress will be measured with data from your agents and integrations. There are no measurements yet.
goalsPage.readOnly: Only someone who manages its scope can change it.
goalsPage.deleteDescription: It is deleted with its measurements. If you just want to stop tracking it, change it to “Archived”. This can't be undone.

errors.invalid: Check the fields: the title can be up to 200 characters, the value is a number (a percentage, up to 100) and the due date can't be before the start.
errors.not_allowed: You can't manage goals in that scope.

integrationsPage.title: Integrations
integrationsPage.description: The business accounts your agents use. You connect them with your own account and can disconnect them at any time.
integrationsPage.adminOnly: Only organization admins can see and connect integrations.
integrationsPage.mfaRequired: You need two-step verification to connect or disconnect integrations.
integrationsPage.unavailable: Integrations are not available in this environment yet.

google-calendar.name: Google Calendar
google-calendar.description: Agents check the calendar of your Google account. Read-only for now.

outlook-calendar.name: Outlook / Microsoft 365
outlook-calendar.description: Agents check the calendar of your Microsoft 365 or Outlook account. Read-only for now.

errors.not_allowed: You are not allowed to change this integration.
errors.unavailable: Integrations are not available in this environment yet.
errors.platform_failed: We could not reach the integration provider. Nothing has changed: try again in a few minutes.

servicesPage.title: Services and team
servicesPage.description: What can be booked, how long it takes and what it costs, and who or what does it at each location. The agents use it to offer slots and book.
servicesPage.mfaRequired: You need the second factor to change services, prices and team.

errors.invalid: Check the details: something can't be saved like this.
errors.not_allowed: You don't have permission to change this.
errors.synced: This comes from an integration: change it there.

servicesPage.priceHelp: The agents that book appointments quote this price to whoever asks. Leave it empty if you don't want to publish it: without a price, they quote none and pass the question to the team.
servicesPage.noServicesYet: There are no services offered at this location yet.
servicesPage.servicesHelp: Only active services offered at the chosen location can be picked.
servicesPage.synced: This comes from an integration and is synced from there: here you can only view it.
servicesPage.servicesEmpty: Create the services that can be booked, with their duration and price.
servicesPage.emptyReadOnly: They'll show up here when someone with permission creates them.
servicesPage.newServiceDescription: What can be booked, how long it takes and, if you like, what it costs.
servicesPage.resourcesEmpty: Add who or what serves at each location and which services they do: without it there are no slots to book.
servicesPage.newResourceDescription: A person, a room or equipment at a location, and the services they do.
servicesPage.hoursHelp: The agents only offer slots within these hours, in the location's time zone.
